Wat bieden wij? €17.75 gross per hour from the age of 21, including holiday pay, statutory vacation days, and ADV allowance; 50% extra pay for working between 10:00 PM and 6:00 AM; 100% extra pay on public holidays; 20 vacation days per year based on a full-time contract of 40 hours per week; Travel allowance of €0.23 per kilometre from 10.1 km up to a maximum of 35 km one-way; Pension plan; Meal allowance for late shifts; Part-time work available; A high level of independence during your working day; Driving a modern Jumbo delivery van; Career development opportunities within Jumbo and Consolid; Prospect of a permanent contract with Jumbo. delivery van. During your shift, you deliver groceries throughout Amsterdam and the surrounding area. Do I need experience? Previous delivery experience is not required.
